title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Shah
description:
Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling agent examples, and docs site quickstarts. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-ready RAG templates and step-by-step quickstarts so developers can onboard agents and tool-calling patterns faster. This PR includes new example agents (search + tool-calling), three RAG templates (conversational RAG, instruction-following RAG, and summarization RAG), updated quickstart pages on the docs site, and lightweight e2e examples that run against the local dev server. Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG templates under examples/rag/templates
- [x] Add agent/tool-calling quickstarts under examples/agents/tool-calling
- [x] Update docs site markdown and TOC entries
- [x] Add unit/integration tests for the example harness
- [x] Ensure no secrets in examples; include guidance for KMS/credentials
Notes: The description contains implementation notes and usage guidance. For production users, the templates include optional KMS integration snippets and a short section on pinning model versions and quantization recommendations. Documentation pages include a short troubleshooting section covering rate limit behaviours and fallback policies.
commits:
1) init: add rag templates and agent examples
2) docs: docs/rag-quickstarts.md with step-by-step guides and TOC update
3) tests: add lightweight example harness + e2e workflow
4) fix: update credentials guidance + remove accidental test secret
5) chore: lint and formatting

release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts. New examples and docs improve developer onboarding for agents and RAG workflows. Not a breaking change.
notes: This PR targets the developer docs and examples surface. Examples are intentionally small and include pointers to production-grade settings (autoscaling, batching, caching, KMS). If further productization is desired, migrate examples to the redwood-examples repo and add long-running e2e scenarios behind a feature flag.
